name: Asian Pan-Fried Tofu with Lemongrass, Cilantro & Chives

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.

Wash and dry the herbs. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Chop chives into small pieces. Place both in a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve lemongrass for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (0.5 oz) pkg Asian-inspired fresh herb blend

instructions.primary_message: Remove any dry outer layers from the lemongrass and discard; mince remaining lemongrass and place in another small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemongrass.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl with the lemongrass and garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add lemongrass, garlic, shallot, and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and fragrant, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the shallots have softened, add tofu and soy sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is warmed through and golden, 6-8 minutes.
When the tofu is done, add reserved cilantro and chives to the skillet, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Enjoy tofu as a filling for lettuce wraps or as part of a rice or noodle bowl!
